lines.text: Buster the little puppy was tossing his favorite red bouncy ball in the park!
Plop! The ball rolled straight into a murky mud puddle and sank out of reach!
Buster sat on the grass, whimpered softly, and let his floppy ears droop down in sadness!
Leo noticed his friend's tears from across the playground and hurried over!
He didn't say Stop crying or It's just a toy! He simply sat beside Buster on the grass!
Leo wrapped his arms around Buster in a warm, gentle, reassuring hug!
A warm hug releases calming happy hormones that soothe racing hearts and bring peace!
Buster licked Leo's cheek, wagged his tail, and together they fished the muddy ball out!
Comfort your friends and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily kindness!
